You NEVER use canola oil when searing good meats. What a way to ruin a good steak.

The canola has a higher smoke point than butter which makes it better for a sear where the butter would burn. Finishing lower with brown butter will add that beautiful nutty flavor that canola can never attain.

Rice bran or grapeseed oil are preferred commercially, if the price point allows, as they have a more neutral flavour on browned meat.

Ghee is the best fat for use the entire way through, it has a high enough smoke point to sear better than vegetable oils and already has those nice nutty browned butter notes. Second best would be tallow, finished with a teaspoon of butter a minute before end of cooking.
